Greetings, Agents!

 

This is CM Fragment of MARVEL Future Fight.

 

A second wave of the Black Widow Update has arrived!

 

Many of our Agents have been eagerly awaiting
what was already previewed in the Legendary Battle - Black Widow mode!

 

New Uniforms for Black Widow and Yelena Belova will be added on 5/6,
so please check them out in MARVEL Future Fight.

 

[Added on 5/6 3:09 a.m. (UTC+0) / 5/5 8:09 p.m. (PDT)]

The patch has been completed. Please reconnect to the game and download the patch file.

 

■ 5/6 Patch
Patch Schedule: 5/6 2:00 a.m. (UTC+0) / 5/5 7:00 p.m. (PDT)
* The patch will be applied in waves. There may be a slight variation in patch time between Agents.
* The game will be available during the patch,
but for better service, please reconnect to the game to apply the patch once it is available.

 

▣ 2 New Uniforms 

 

 

* New Uniform Skills are based on Level 1 stats.
* The 2 New Uniforms will be on sale during the event and will be available for purchase in the MARVEL Universe and Uniform Room after the event.
* The New Uniforms will be available for purchase after the 5/6 patch is applied and will be available at discounted prices.

* Black Widow <MARVEL’s Black Widow (Snow Suit)> and Black Widow <MARVEL’s Black Widow> are synergy uniforms, and both the synergy uniform discount and event uniform discount will be applied.
* Yelena Belova <MARVEL’s Black Widow> and Yelena Belova <MARVEL’s Black Widow(Snow Suit)> are synergy uniforms, and both the synergy uniform discount and event uniform discount will be applied.


▣ Other Information

 

1. An issue, where under certain conditions, passive skills of certain characters aren't activated after reaching Tier-2 or Tier-3 by using selectors or tickets, has been fixed.


More themed updates are in the works, so stay tuned for new changes!

 

Thank you.
